## Appearance

Obed Abernethy is an unusual-appearing individual with an awkward frame, hunching shoulders, and warm brown eyes. He has lengthy, iron-gray hair that reaches his shoulders and has maintained a thick, gentle brown beard since the age of twenty.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P34](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0034)_

## Personality

Obed Abernethy is a quiet, bashful, and extremely shy individual who exhibits a remarkably timid nature. Taciturn and often silent, he rarely voices grievances or engages in full discussions, instead standing by as a patient, wise, and good-natured listener who appreciates loquacious companions. Despite his general bashfulness, he possesses a quiet stubbornness, clinging tenaciously to his own views once adopted. He harbors a deep-seated fear of little girls, as well as an aversion to women in general, excepting [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and Mrs. Agatha. Furthermore, he despises being surrounded by unfamiliar people or visiting places where he might be required to converse.

## History

Obed Abernethy lived at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), having inherited the timid and bashful nature of his father. Wearing a thick, gentle brown beard since his twenties, he traveled to the train station expecting to collect an orphan boy to help on the farm, only to bring home an unexpected orphan girl named [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) instead. Although [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) initially intended to send the child back, Obed harbored a quiet desire to keep her and offered the young girl his steady support. He secretly visited [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in her room to persuade her to apologize to a neighbor after a outburst, and he later gifted her chocolates as Thirza's affection for the girl grew. Noticing how poorly [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) dressed compared to her friends, Obed made an awkward attempt to shop for stylish fabric and secured help to have a new [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gown made with fashionable puffed sleeves for her. He celebrated Nell's academic successes over the years, including her tying for first place on the island during her entrance examinations. In his old age, Obed suffered from significant heart trouble. After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) achieved further success at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy), news of a local bank failure caused Obed to collapse and die, leaving [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) in mourning.

## Quotes

> "Indeed, she failed to do so. The girl was brought by her. This was confirmed by my query to the stationmaster. Consequently, bringing her back fell upon me. Leaving her at that place was impossible, regardless of how the error originated."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER III. Thirza Abernethy Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005)

> "Young Tobias Buote from the Creek came by earlier today, and I informed him that I thought I would take him on for the summer season."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P43](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0043)

> "I suppose she should receive a bit of punishment. However, Thirza, refrain from being overly strict with her. Keep in mind that she has never possessed anybody to instruct her properly. You—you intend to provide her with food, do you not?"
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P3](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0003)

> "You realize it is bound to happen eventually, because Thirza possesses a terrible resolve—a terrible resolve, Nell. My advice is to perform it immediately and get it done."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013)

> "Indeed—you are correct, Nell. However, keep Thirza from knowing I mentioned a word regarding it. She could believe I was meddling, and I gave my word to refrain from doing so."
>
> — Obed Abernethy — [v1 CHAPTER X. Nell’s Apology P19](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0019)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--obed-abernethy.md)

Obed serves as a guardian and beloved friend to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), an orphan girl who arrives at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) expecting a boy's workload. While his sister [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) initially pushes to send [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back, Obed harbors a quiet desire to keep her and treats her with kindness, such as secretly visiting her bedroom to persuade her to apologize to a neighbor and gifting her chocolates. Over time, both he and [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) take on parental roles as they raise [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) together at their home.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/obed-abernethy--thirza-abernethy.md)

Obed and [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) are siblings who live together at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and eventually raise [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) as guardians. Although Obed is more soft-hearted and quietly favors keeping [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) from the beginning, he defers to Thirza's firmer household decisions and leadership. Despite their initial disagreements over how to handle Nell's arrival, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) keeps him informed of her plans for the girl's upbringing, and the two work together to maintain their home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Obed Abernethy Is Surprised P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Nell’s Confession P51](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0051), +5 more_
